# Sahil Thorat — Portfolio

> Influencer Marketing Executive, Video Editor, and Content Producer based in Mumbai, India.

## About
Sahil Thorat is a creative Content Producer, Influencer Marketing Executive, and Video Editor based in Mumbai. He specializes in end-to-end campaign execution, short-form Reels & Shorts video editing, YouTube content production, and brand partnerships with leading Indian and global brands.

## Core Services
- Influencer Marketing: Strategy, creator onboarding, brand campaigns, ROI tracking.
- Video Editing: Commercials, YouTube videos, Instagram Reels, Shorts, motion graphics.
- Content Production: End-to-end media production, scriptwriting, creative direction.
- Event Coordination: On-ground influencer management and event execution.

## Key Portfolio Highlights & Brands
- Collaborated with brands like ICICI Bank, Flipkart, Tata Motors, Sony SAB, My11Circle, Puma India, Nykaa, Boat Lifestyle, Mamaearth, and Urban Monkey.
- Managed 100+ influencer campaigns and produced viral short-form video content.
